meta.title: Change the shared proxy settings: proposed

frontend.label: UI step where the work started

nodes.label: devhost caddy --help
nodes.explanation: Find where the shared Caddy settings live (read only). devhost caddy --help ends with 'Ports, listeners and the stack directory hostname are shared Caddy settings in the devhost config file: ~/.config/devhost/config.toml', the path resolved from DEVHOST_CONFIG_DIR, else XDG_CONFIG_HOME, else ~/.config/devhost, as today, shortened with ~ (WORD-1, WORD-8, SURF-15). privileged-ports' help reads 'Let Caddy listen on ports below 1024 without root (Linux; downloads Caddy if needed and asks for your password)'; on Linux it names the download before it starts and the size once known, says before sudo that it may ask for a password, and a download that replaces a binary holding the grant ends with 'Run devhost caddy privileged-ports again' (WORD-9). On macOS it says bindHost 127.0.0.1 applies only from port 1024 (O39). Under AGENT=1 it refuses before any sudo with 'Ask the person to run devhost caddy privileged-ports in a terminal', as REV-8 requires of every step that asks for a password. Keys: none; terminal output only. Resolves proxy-settings-05.

sources.label: Replaces: caddy help without config.toml
Replaces: privileged-ports help line
Reuses: file path from env vars, else HOME

nodes.label: Proxy line at start
nodes.explanation: devhost caddy start names what runs, its listener, the file and how to stop it: 'Caddy runs HTTPS on port 443 on every interface, reachable from your network · settings: ~/.config/devhost/config.toml · stop it with devhost caddy stop' (FB-10). devhost start and devhost status (O62) print the same facts as one proxy line, 'Proxy: HTTPS on port 443, every interface, reachable from your network · ~/.config/devhost/config.toml'; bindHost 127.0.0.1 with every port from 1024 reads 'Proxy: HTTPS on 127.0.0.1:4443 and [::1]:4443, direct connections from this machine only; relay previews and SSH forwards still reach it' (O39). On macOS with bindHost 127.0.0.1 and any port below 1024, Caddy keeps every interface and a warning naming httpsPort = 4443 or a privileged launcher follows on every start, status and save; nothing is refused (O39, WORD-7). Agent output carries the same facts with the absolute path (WORD-9, FB-11). The line is built from the record of what Caddy runs. stack-run-stop, first-run-setup and serve-folder print it. Resolves the silence of proxy-settings-01.

nodes.label: Edit [caddy] and save
nodes.explanation: Change a setting (one write, applied through hot reload). The person edits httpsPort, http and httpPort, bindHost, stackDirectoryHost, stackDirectoryAllowRemote, adminAddress, domainSuffix or [remote] and saves, in any editor or in the Configuration window: off by default (owner rule), and with it on, it saves from this machine and from a browser elsewhere signed in with the shared devhost passkey or paired (O36, O54); an unauthenticated browser sees the unauthenticated state (HOLD-7). Nothing asks: a save is reported, never reviewed (REV-1, REV-10). Every running stack watches config.toml, and the first to take the shared route lock applies the change once for the machine. A save made while a move runs waits for it; a lost response takes its outcome from the record by its operationId and never saves again; a stale base is refused with 'Not saved: the file changed on disk', the draft kept (REV-12, REV-13, UNDO-3). An agent's save reads '· after config.toml changed on disk' (ACT-1). Keys: Mod+S saves in the window (KEY-9).

sources.label: Reuses: save checks the file, then writes it
Reuses: every stack's watch loop

nodes.label: Reach stated beside Save
nodes.explanation: In the Configuration window, with config.toml picked under 'devbox', 'Changes here apply to every stack on devbox' sits under the header (O61), and beside Save one line states what saving does, from /__devhost__/config/validate (read only, CC-37): 'Saving moves the URLs of 3 stacks to port 4443: Acme Shop, Acme Platform and Acme Admin; no service restarts' (REV-10, SEL-1, SEL-6, SEL-11, O45). Per setting it names plain HTTP added or removed; 'reachable only from devbox ... relay previews and SSH forwards still reach them' or, warning style, 'reachable from devbox's network'; on macOS below port 1024 'Saving keeps 3 stacks reachable from devbox's network' (O39); the directory's new URL; anonymous directory access (O47); the admin API moved; the stacks a domainSuffix or [remote] change waits for; 'Changes nothing that runs'; and 'This page moves to port 4443; its unsent chat text and page context come along' (REV-3, UNDO-2). Statements, never a question. Problems show on their line before the save and are checked again when the running settings change (MENU-4, REV-13). Resolves the reach slice of proxy-settings-04.

sources.label: Replaces: config check returns only problems
Reuses: validate route for unsaved text

nodes.label: Check before Caddy moves
nodes.explanation: One check runs before anything moves, the same for a save, devhost start's apply, devhost caddy start and the validate route (REV-11, read only): the file's validation, each problem with its file, line, column and key, the offending line and a close key (MENU-4); a probe of each new listener port (httpsPort, and httpPort while http = true) on 127.0.0.1, ::1 and the bind host, naming the program and PID that hold it, Caddy's own listeners excluded (FAIL-3); and a stackDirectoryHost that a running stack's service uses, named by stack, service and manifest line, never by a PID alone (WORD-4). A failed check refuses the change with nothing moved, and every stack keeps the running shared Caddy settings (HOLD-6). A loopback bindHost below port 1024 on macOS is not refused: it applies with its warning (O39). A devhost start whose service host is the stack directory's is refused naming config.toml line 4 and caddy.stackDirectoryHost. The port probe is the one manifest-hot-reload builds. Resolves proxy-settings-02 and the collision words of proxy-settings-04.

sources.label: Reuses: validation names each bad key
Replaces: read, then apply with no port check
Replaces: collision that names only a PID

nodes.label: Tell pages, move once
nodes.explanation: When the change moves a listener (a port, http or the bind host), the applying process first calls each running stack's control server on the loopback control port the state directory records, and each stack sends every page whose address changes {type: listeners-moving, origin, operationId}; relayed pages keep public port 443 and get none; a stack that does not answer within 1 s never holds the move up (HOLD-2). Caddy then moves in one reload under the route lock, adminAddress included, every configured route on the new port, stopped stacks' 24 h routes included, while an unconfigured hostname gets no certificate (O63, O15). On macOS a loopback bindHost renders default_bind 127.0.0.1 [::1] when every port is 1024 or above, as on Linux; below that every interface stays, with the warning (O39; proxy-settings-01). devhost certifies the move on every address the bind host resolves to: a TLS handshake with the stack directory's hostname, and a plain request on the HTTP port, reach Caddy within 5 s (FB-5); only then is the record written. Services keep running and no service restarts (ACT-2, O45; proxy-settings-06).

sources.label: Replaces: macOS skips the loopback bind
Reuses: one reload under the route lock

nodes.label: Stacks follow the record
nodes.explanation: Only a certified move writes the record of what Caddy runs (applied.json), now with the operation ID, its origin (a save of config.toml, devhost start or a devhost serve session with its folder, or devhost caddy start), the time, the resolved listeners and the config.toml text it was read from (ACT-1). Every running stack watches it beside config.toml and follows it whoever moved Caddy: it replaces its own copy, publishes its state, prints its outcome line, and clears its devhost config file rejection when the running settings equal config.toml (ACT-7, ACT-12, FAIL-4). Printed URLs, the toolbar's links, later reloads, Restart Stack, switches and the relay connector read their ports from it, as the stack directory already does, so every surface names one port; Show Differences and Restore Running Version read its text (UNDO-6). A stack busy with its own operation follows when that ends (HOLD-3, REV-12). Resolves proxy-settings-07: running stacks kept the old port's links after a start applied a change a save could not.

sources.label: Replaces: each stack's own copy of settings
Reuses: applied.json written after a reload
Replaces: URLs from each stack's own copy

nodes.label: Applied config.toml
nodes.explanation: Each stack prints one outcome line in its terminal and log, then only what changed: 'Applied config.toml: HTTPS port 443 → 4443 · 1.4 s · after config.toml changed on disk', its moved URLs by service and stack-run-stop's 'All stacks on devbox: https://devhost.localhost:4443/' (FB-3, FB-7, FB-10, WORD-4, CC-22, O61). Each changed key reads old → new ('bindHost 0.0.0.0 → 127.0.0.1: direct connections from this machine only'); plain HTTP adds each HTTP URL; a bindHost or port change adds the proxy line and, on macOS below port 1024, its warning (O39); anonymous directory access adds a warning line (O47); a start that applied the file ends '· from the terminal (devhost caddy start)'; a save that changes nothing that runs prints 'Applied config.toml: nothing changed'. Agent output prints the same facts on one line (WORD-9, FB-11). The Configuration window shows 'Applied config.toml: moved the URLs of 3 stacks to port 4443 · 1.4 s', focus on its sentence (FB-2, FB-9). There is no Undo: saving the old value reports its own move (UNDO-6). Resolves the outcome slice of proxy-settings-04.

sources.label: Replaces: Applied line, then every URL again
Replaces: every service URL logged again

nodes.label: Pages follow: Open
nodes.explanation: On listeners-moving a page keeps working on the old address, shows '◐ Moving to port 4443' (FB-13, FB-1) and hands its unsent chat text, pasted images and page context to the draft record under the new address (UNDO-2). When its stream closes it connects its status stream to the same hostname on the new port; until that answers, every service keeps its last state as unknown, 'last seen 14:02', never down (ACT-5, CC-26). Once every listener confirms (listeners-moved), notices-and-feedback's success notice reads '✓ Moved to https://shop.localhost:4443/' with 'This page still uses port 443, which closed when config.toml changed.' and Open, which opens this page at port 4443 in the same tab with path, query and fragment kept (HOLD-2, SURF-15, FB-5). Every write on the old page reads 'This page still uses port 443. Open it at port 4443 to make changes.' (HOLD-1, MENU-3). The notice never takes focus, is announced once, stays until Open or Dismiss, fits every acceptance viewport and the 320 px phone layout (O8); Dismiss leaves 'moved' on the stack name (KEY-6, FB-8, FB-9, SURF-8, SURF-9). Resolves this flow's slice of proxy-settings-03.

sources.label: Replaces: all down, retrying the old origin
Replaces: every service marked failed
Reuses: health stream that only reads

nodes.label: Not applied: file:line
nodes.explanation: Nothing moves. Each running stack prints one line led by the file, line, column and key, then the cause, the fix and what keeps running, the offending line under it: '~/.config/devhost/config.toml:3:13 not applied: caddy.httpsPort: port 4443 is in use by nc (PID 77959) on 127.0.0.1. Choose another port or stop that program. Every stack keeps the running shared Caddy settings: HTTPS on port 443, every interface.' It blocks nothing (FAIL-2, MENU-4, HOLD-6). The same form names an out-of-range value and a directory hostname by stack and service; a save while Caddy is stopped reads 'config.toml not applied yet: devhost's proxy is not running. devhost caddy start applies it.' (proxy-settings-07). Every open page shows '◆ devhost config file not applied: config.toml line 3, column 13, …' led by Edit, then Copy Error; with the editor off Copy Error leads and devhost opens no editor (O51); an unsigned browser elsewhere gets no status stream (HOLD-7, O38). The window marks lines that differ from what runs, with Show Differences and Restore Running Version (UNDO-6). A repeat counts '2 times, last at 14:05' (FAIL-4). Resolves the rejection words of proxy-settings-04.

sources.label: Replaces: rejection logged; a fix logs nothing
Replaces: devhost config change not applied

nodes.label: Uncertified: restored
nodes.explanation: When the handshake fails, for example because a program took 127.0.0.1:4443 after the probe, devhost reloads Caddy to the running settings and writes no record, and the change is not applied with its cause (FB-5, REV-11): '~/.config/devhost/config.toml:3:13 not applied: caddy.httpsPort: port 4443 answered on 127.0.0.1 but not through Caddy; another program holds it for IPv4. Restored the running shared Caddy settings: HTTPS on port 443, every interface.' This is devhost's own rollback (UNDO-1), and its outcome names what it restored, the running shared Caddy settings. A page that received listeners-moving reconnects to the old address, which answers again within 5 s, and its activity line gives way to the not-applied notice, never to 'Moved to https://shop.localhost:4443/' (REV-13, FB-13; proxy-settings-03). A reload Caddy refuses keeps Caddy on the settings it runs and renders its files back for them, as today. Never 'Applied config.toml' for a listener that does not answer through Caddy on every address its bind host resolves to. Resolves the certification half of proxy-settings-02.

sources.label: Reuses: a refused reload renders running back

nodes.label: Relay follows the record

sources.label: Replaces: guard expects Caddy's local port
Replaces: lease captures the port at start
Replaces: machine-wide lock per request

nodes.explanation: A remote stack's public port is 443: the control server's origin check and every helper that rebuilds a stack URL match a relayed page against it, never Caddy's local httpsPort, so on a machine whose Caddy uses 4443 a relayed page's toolbar shows 6 of 6 running and a signed-in browser's Restart, Restart Stack, Start, switches and chat pass as on 443 (O36, relay-previews-01); a start whose own public origin is refused fails with a named cause. The relay connector takes Caddy's address from the record whenever it changes, never from the port a lease captured at start, so a move by a save, another project's start or a serve session leaves every preview answering; when it cannot reach Caddy, the remote stack prints 'Acme Shop's relay previews cannot reach Caddy at 127.0.0.1:4443. Start it with devhost caddy start' (relay-previews-08). It keeps the lease table in memory, reloaded within 250 ms, and reuses keep-alive TLS connections (relay-previews-07). Services read their public URL from X-Forwarded-Proto and X-Forwarded-Host; the docs teach it (O45, proxy-settings-06).

nodes.label: Waits for its next start

sources.label: Replaces: routing change refuses whole save

nodes.explanation: A domainSuffix change waits only for the stacks it changes: a running local stack waits for its next start only when a hostname of its accepted manifest comes from a short host label; a stack whose hostnames are full names records the new suffix for later reloads and shows no rejection. A remote stack waits for a [remote] change the same way. A waiting stack still applies or follows the save's [caddy] part, so Caddy never stays on the old port, and prints 'config.toml's domainSuffix waits for Acme Admin's next start: admin.localhost → admin--devbox.devhost.acme.test' with devhost stack restart on its own line; its pages show '◆ domainSuffix waits for a restart' with Restart Now, which starts the stack's next run in the shared supervisor, and Copy Command (HOLD-6, WORD-8, ACT-7, O18, CC-53; owner item q84a1). A later save while it waits is applied and reported, never refused in silence (FAIL-4). Restart Stack keeps the hostnames the stack started with. Resolves proxy-settings-08, and with the relay, relay-previews-08.

cards.title: What changes versus today
items: Removed: bindHost = "127.0.0.1" silently widened to every interface on macOS (now loopback from port 1024, a warning below it); 'Applied the shared Caddy settings from <path>.' followed by every URL again; 'shared Caddy settings rejected: <error chain>'; the title 'devhost config change not applied'; 'managed caddy does not need privileged-port setup on macOS.'; every service drawn down on a page whose port moved; the directory collision that names only a PID; a routing change refusing the whole save; relayed pages refused when Caddy is not on 443

Merged: applied, rejected and 'change not applied' become one event; each stack's copy of the settings, each relay lease's captured address and the record of what Caddy runs become one record every surface and the relay read

New: the config file's path in caddy --help; the proxy line and its macOS warning; reach stated beside Save; checks, certification and restore; listeners-moving and pages that follow with Open; the change summary; waiting-suffix and waiting-relay lines and notice; the connector's unreachable line and start self-check; privileged-ports' lines and AGENT=1 refusal; Restart Now on a waiting stack's pages (owner decision)

Changed: on macOS a loopback bindHost listens on loopback from port 1024; running stacks and relay previews follow a change a start applied; a held port is refused before the move; a rejection clears whenever config.toml matches what runs; a routing change waits only for the stacks it changes

Kept: file location and defaults; every interface by default (owner rule); hot reload with no question and no service restart (O45); one reload under the route lock, never applied twice; refused changes keep the running settings; config editor off by default; strict TLS for configured hostnames (O63); only a person changes trust (REV-8)

Check, move once and certify: proxy-settings-02, proxy-settings-01 (P1)

Slices here, the rest elsewhere: proxy-settings-03 (notices-and-feedback: a lost connection is never an outage); proxy-settings-04 (stack-run-stop: the directory URL with the service URLs; manifest-hot-reload: clearing a rejection prints a line)
Related, not covered: network-exposure-01 (agent-chat's O36 check, shipping with O39); stack-directory-06 (stack-run-stop, stack-directory)

cards.title: Backend work
items: Structured issues for config.toml: file, line, column, key, the offending line and a close key (MENU-4)
One check before every move: listener ports probed on 127.0.0.1, ::1 and the bind host naming the holder; stackDirectoryHost checked against running stacks and reserved at start (REV-11)
macOS loopback listener: default_bind 127.0.0.1 [::1] when every port is 1024 or above, every interface and a warning below (O39)
Pages told before the move: listeners-moving through each stack's loopback control port, at most 1 s per stack; drafts kept under the new origin; the status stream readable from the old address
The move certified with the stack directory's hostname and restored when it fails; every configured route, stopped stacks' included, on the new port (O63)
One record of what Caddy runs, with origin, time, listeners and text, followed by every stack and the relay connector
The outcome line, the plan for a draft, the proxy line, privileged-ports' lines and AGENT=1 refusal
Routing settings decided per stack; a remote stack's public port; the connector following the record with an in-memory lease table and pooled connections
Restart Now: POST /__devhost__/new-run starts a waiting stack's next run in the shared supervisor, as devhost stack restart does, under O37's check (CC-53)

cards.title: Contract changes
items: CC-22: one outcome line for every operation on a running stack; URLs print at the first start and on request, not after each action (stack-run-stop lands it)
CC-23 (with O62): devhost status carries the proxy line; devhost reload --dry-run prints the plan for config.toml
CC-26: a lost connection is unknown, never down; a page whose port moved draws unknown until the new address answers
CC-27 (with O63, O15): configured-hosts-only TLS stays; stopped stacks' 24 h routes move with the port
CC-37: /__devhost__/config/validate returns what saving would do, the URLs it moves included; config/save takes an operationId
CC-39 (with O61): machineName names devbox in the reach lines

CC-43: shared-managed-caddy-settings.md macOS bullet (O39), its move, rejection and routing sentences; remote-previews.md any Caddy port; service-references.md and environment-variables.md public URL from the request (O45); cli.md and managed-caddy.md privileged-ports, with the REV-8 refusal
CC-53: a waiting stack's pages offer Restart Now, which starts its next run and moves the page; control-api.md gains POST /__devhost__/new-run (owner decision q84a1)
